WITH latest_snapshots AS (SELECT snapshot_date FROM scores.stage_snapshots WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)),
sector_breadth AS (SELECT sector, MAX(pct_above_50dma) AS max_pct_above_50dma FROM breadth.sector_daily WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM breadth.sector_daily) GROUP BY sector),
sector_stage AS (SELECT sector, COUNT(*) AS stage2_count FROM scores.stage_snapshots WHERE stage = 'STAGE_2' AND snapshot_date = (SELECT snapshot_date FROM latest_snapshots) GROUP BY sector)
